import React from "react"; import { FaRobot, FaBrain, FaProjectDiagram, FaExclamationTriangle, FaCode, FaDatabase, FaBullseye, FaEye, FaRocket } from "react-icons/fa"; function About() { return (
{/* Heading */}

About Smart Impact Analyzer

AI-Based Requirement Change Impact Analysis System

{/* Project Overview */}

Project Overview

Smart Impact Analyzer is an AI-powered software platform that helps software teams analyze requirement changes, predict affected modules, identify dependencies, estimate project risks, and generate intelligent reports.

Using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing, the system improves software planning while reducing development cost and time.

{/* Problem Statement */}

Problem Statement

Time Consuming

Manual impact analysis requires significant effort.

Hidden Dependencies

Software dependencies are difficult to identify.

Human Errors

Manual analysis often misses critical modules.

Project Risk

Requirement changes increase software risks.

{/* Proposed Solution */}

Proposed Solution

  • ✔ AI-Based Requirement Analysis
  • ✔ Machine Learning Prediction
  • ✔ NLP Requirement Comparison
  • ✔ Dependency Detection
  • ✔ Risk Prediction
  • ✔ Automatic Report Generation
{/* Workflow */}

System Workflow

Requirement
➡
AI Analysis
➡
Dependency
➡
Risk Prediction
➡
Report
{/* Technology */}

Technology Stack

React.js
MySQL
Machine Learning
Spring Boot
{/* Mission Vision Goal */}

Mission

Reduce software risks using AI-powered impact analysis.

Vision

Build smarter software engineering solutions worldwide.

Goal

Improve productivity, quality and software reliability.

); } export default About;
